These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

Book me a window seat on the earliest flight from Bucharest to Vienna next Tuesday.

Please rename every file in the reports folder that ends in .tmp so that it ends in .bak instead.

Send Maria the slides from yesterday's meeting, but don't cc anyone from the sales team.

Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at 9 a.m., and again an hour later if I haven't marked it done.

Order two large pizzas, one vegetarian and one with extra cheese, and have them delivered to the office.

Cancel all my meetings on Friday afternoon except the one with the investors.

Archive the emails from last quarter, but keep the ones that are flagged as important in the inbox.

Tom thinks the server crashed because of a memory leak, but I'm not convinced.

My manager told me that the project would be cancelled unless we found a sponsor.

Maria asked whether anyone had seen her keys.

I am frustrated by how many unrelated details I have to keep track of.

Which of these requests can be handled now, and which need clarification?

List the unresolved questions before taking any action.

Mira is a physicist. She owns a workstation.

Sensor S1 is red and is mounted on the north wall.

Catalyst C7 speeds up reaction R2 without being consumed by it.

Bob sent Alice the report on Monday.

The report was approved by Dana after the audit.

Leo entered the lab, then he switched off the alarm.

If a server is overloaded, the scheduler moves new jobs elsewhere. Node7 is a server and is overloaded.

Every researcher who owns a GPU can run a local model. Ana is a researcher and owns GPU1, which is a GPU.

No reviewer may approve a paper they authored. Nina is a reviewer and authored paper7.

Sample3 is clean, while sample4 is contaminated.

Not every request requires authentication; public status requests do not. R17 is a public status request.

I am annoyed about the delay, not about the person helping me.

Can you identify any conflicting requirements in these notes?

Point out contradictions rather than resolving them without asking me.

mentions.text: "We want a formalizer that converts English requests into a canonical controlled language."
mentions.label: We want a formalizer that converts English requests into a canonical controlled language.

mentions.text: "Every candidate formalization must preserve negation, modality, quantifiers, temporal order, and references."
mentions.label: Every candidate formalization must preserve negation, modality, quantifiers, temporal order, and references.

mentions.text: "If the symbolic parser is uncertain, mark the ambiguity instead of guessing."
mentions.label: If the symbolic parser is uncertain, mark the ambiguity instead of guessing.

mentions.text: "Find three difficult examples involving pronouns and modal scope."
mentions.label: Find three difficult examples involving pronouns and modal scope.

mentions.text: "Do not include examples that require specialist medical knowledge."
mentions.label: Do not include examples that require specialist medical knowledge.

mentions.text: "Bob told Alan that he should review the report."
mentions.label: Bob told Alan that he should review the report.

mentions.text: "Not every reviewer must accept a paper."
mentions.label: Not every reviewer must accept a paper.

mentions.text: "Does that mean some reviewer is not required to accept a paper?"
mentions.label: Does that mean some reviewer is not required to accept a paper?

mentions.text: "Before Ada approves the report, Bob must review it."
mentions.label: Before Ada approves the report, Bob must review it.

mentions.text: "If Bob rejects it, Ada should not publish it."
mentions.label: If Bob rejects it, Ada should not publish it.

mentions.text: "Use the report from the previous example."
mentions.label: Use the report from the previous example.

mentions.text: "The evaluator may accept a candidate only if no material meaning is missing."
mentions.label: The evaluator may accept a candidate only if no material meaning is missing.

mentions.text: "It may reject a candidate because the CNL invents a condition that is not present in the source."
mentions.label: It may reject a candidate because the CNL invents a condition that is not present in the source.

mentions.text: "If the source is ambiguous and the context does not resolve it, the evaluator must return uncertain."
mentions.label: If the source is ambiguous and the context does not resolve it, the evaluator must return uncertain.

mentions.text: "Show me which candidates were rejected and why."
mentions.label: Show me which candidates were rejected and why.

mentions.text: "Keep the explanation short, but preserve the exact evidence spans."
mentions.label: Keep the explanation short, but preserve the exact evidence spans.

mentions.text: "We prefer one batched LLM call over one call per sentence."
mentions.label: We prefer one batched LLM call over one call per sentence.

mentions.text: "When ten candidates are ready, validate them together."
mentions.label: When ten candidates are ready, validate them together.

mentions.text: "Do not wait for ten if the user explicitly asks for an immediate verdict."
mentions.label: Do not wait for ten if the user explicitly asks for an immediate verdict.

mentions.text: "A candidate that passes the symbolic audit can still be wrong."
mentions.label: A candidate that passes the symbolic audit can still be wrong.

mentions.text: "Therefore sample some apparently safe candidates for LLM review."
mentions.label: Therefore sample some apparently safe candidates for LLM review.

mentions.text: "How many of the last twenty candidates were judged equivalent?"
mentions.label: How many of the last twenty candidates were judged equivalent?

mentions.text: "If fewer than eighteen were equivalent, report the failure rate."
mentions.label: If fewer than eighteen were equivalent, report the failure rate.

mentions.text: "The judge must not use world knowledge to fill missing information."
mentions.label: The judge must not use world knowledge to fill missing information.

mentions.text: "Only information licensed by the source or the conversation may be used."
mentions.label: Only information licensed by the source or the conversation may be used.

mentions.text: "Can the formalizer distinguish 'does not have to submit' from 'must not submit'?"
mentions.label: Can the formalizer distinguish 'does not have to submit' from 'must not submit'?

mentions.text: "Test both readings and mark any scope error."
mentions.label: Test both readings and mark any scope error.

mentions.text: "Finally, return the CNL, the symbolic warnings, and the LLM verdict for each tested turn."
mentions.label: Finally, return the CNL, the symbolic warnings, and the LLM verdict for each tested turn.

mentions.text: "I am relieved that we are finally making progress, but I am still impatient."
mentions.label: I am relieved that we are finally making progress, but I am still impatient.

mentions.text: "What should be checked first, and why?"
mentions.label: What should be checked first, and why?

text:
These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

Book me a window seat on the earliest flight from Bucharest to Vienna next Tuesday.

Please rename every file in the reports folder that ends in .tmp so that it ends in .bak instead.

Send Maria the slides from yesterday's meeting, but don't cc anyone from the sales team.

Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at 9 a.m., and again an hour later if I haven't marked it done.

Order two large pizzas, one vegetarian and one with extra cheese, and have them delivered to the office.

Cancel all my meetings on Friday afternoon except the one with the investors.

Archive the emails from last quarter, but keep the ones that are flagged as important in the inbox.

Tom thinks the server crashed because of a memory leak, but I'm not convinced.

My manager told me that the project would be cancelled unless we found a sponsor.

Maria asked whether anyone had seen her keys.

I am frustrated by how many unrelated details I have to keep track of.

Which of these requests can be handled now, and which need clarification?

List the unresolved questions before taking any action.

These notes concern separate situations unless I explicitly connect them.

Ravi plans to buy a laptop next month. He has compared three models, but he has not placed an order. Has Ravi bought the laptop?

Every employee who handles customer data must complete privacy training. Ana is an employee and handles customer data. Has Ana completed the training?

If a payment exceeds 10,000 euros, a director must approve it before it is released. Payment P7 is for 12,500 euros and has been released. Was P7 necessarily approved by a director?

Lea told Omar that the server was offline. Omar did not verify the claim. Is the server definitely offline?

The backup runs every night unless maintenance mode is enabled. Maintenance mode was enabled last night. Did the backup run last night?

The application allows a user to download the dataset only if that user is registered. It allowed Niko to download the dataset. Is Niko registered?

Maria submitted the revised proposal on Monday. Leo forwarded it to Iris on Tuesday, and Iris archived it after reading it. Who archived the proposal?

Two sensors failed during the test, but neither was replaced. Did any failed sensor get replaced?

Every paper has at least one author. There is an author who wrote three papers. Is there an author who wrote at least one paper?

Alice did not promise to attend the meeting. Bob thinks she promised not to attend it. Did Alice promise to attend?

I am frustrated by how many unrelated details I have to keep track of.

Which of these requests can be handled now, and which need clarification?

List the unresolved questions before taking any action.
